releaseNotes:
1. 4 Independent Counting Metrics: Unique Crossing Records (162 baseline / 60 detected), Total Crossing Spans (147 distinct spans), Feeders Covered (25 feeders), and Physical GIS Intersection Events.
2. Mutual EHT Intersection Architecture: Dual feeder-wise records sharing a unified intersection_event_id with geodesic distance duplicate protection.
3. Direction-Independent Span Normalization: Directional invariance (Loc A <-> Loc B) for span tracking.
4. Category Protection & Elevation: Protected Main River from silent canal reclassification; elevated category cards to display both feeders and spans without category filters mutating global totals.
5. Global 4-Metric Banner: High-contrast responsive banner across abstract sheet and register.
